Dead Plate

A downloadable game for Windows and macOS

Download NowName your own price




Dead Plate is a short 2D restaurant tycoon themed rpg horror game with visual novel and point-and-click elements  set in 1960s France following the story of a lively waiter named Rody trying to make as much money as possible in a week at a fancy bistro owned by a charismatic and successful chef, Vince.


◣━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━◢

🍽️  DEVELOPMENT & STORY & GRAPHICS  🍽️



:: RachelDrawsThis 
:: Ekrix


🍷  COMPOSER & SOUND DESIGNER  🍷
:: BellKalengar


🥩  FEATURES  🥩
:: 70+ CGs + 8 maps
:: Classic restaurant tycoon styled gameplay
:: Character-driven story with 8k+ of dialogue
:: Original soundtrack


⏲️  ESTIMATED PLAY TIME  ⏲️
:: 1 hour  20 ~ 30 minutes for an ending
:: Up to 3 hours in total for completion


🔥  NUMBER OF ENDINGS  🔥
:: 4
(+ Different dialogues and hidden secrets/details)

Here's the official endings guide for those who may need it.

◣━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━◢

🥀  WARNING  🥀

:: TWs include: 
graphic death, blood, gore, violence, cannibalism, eyestrain, disturbing imagery and audio.

There may be spoilers in the comments section of this page, try your best to avoid it until finishing the game!

💔 KNOWN BUG S 💔

- If you can't seem to interact with objects, make sure you're pressing the correct direction (press arrow keys first) before pressing [Z]. 

- If you can't seem to clean up a table,
 try pressing [Z] from the bottom right side of the table.

- There is a very inconsistent body double glitch where sometimes two protagonist sprites show up rather than one at the very end of one of the endings. If this ocrrus, please ignore.

◣━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━◢

All tips and feedback are greatly appreciated.

Support us by leaving a tip when downloading the game
or on Ko-fi for the studio's future game development!

Thank you for dining at La Gueule de Saturne, 
hope you enjoy the game!

from the very bottom of my heart, i'll say this with my full chest. this is easily one of my favourite games ever. beyond the incredible story, it's just a damn good game. i really enjoyed the controls!!! it took a little getting used to, but i just fell in love with them. the restaurant aspect was so much fun to play, and i felt it was the perfect difficulty. just ignore how i was screaming in my groupchat over how bad i was struggling lol. if you want a challenge, try make a perfect service; managing all of the tables is harder than it looks.  or maybe it's a skill issue on my end. either way, i thoroughly enjoyed that part of the game. 

I won't say much on the ending and story, so as to not spoil anyone reading through the comments, but my god, it was good. the foreshadowing was excellent. i loved replaying it, and thinking "oh. oh."  every line/scene.  the cast is really interesting, and i love the little details we get about their lives/past. it helps make the world feel more lived-in. the setting was a great choice, and i particularly like the time-period as i believe the main themes are very relevant to that time. manonnnnn i miss you wife come home :broken_heart: . bro vincent is so interesting to me, and i appreciate he isn't cartoonishly evil- the effort put in to make it clear he isn't just doing this for the shit's and giggles did wonders for the narrative. BUT NONE CAN TOP RODY-NATION WOOOOO. loved rody's character so much. he doesn't have a huge character arc in the story (we do get hints at a character arc before the story occurs), but he was a brilliant protagonist!!! i haven't seen many explore characters like him before, so it was already going to interest me, but the execution was superb. the tension in the endings was also really good!! my heart was beating so fast i could hear lmao. the horror was well-done

all around, a fantastic game. can't wait to replay it :) 

 okay but we must have words about the jumpscare i got when i just saw an eye in the wall. nearly fell out of seat with how i launched back/pos

Hey there, did you manage to play the game? I've had the exact same issue! 

Here's how to make it work:

_______________________________

1. Download the game 

2. Open your downloads.

There should be two seperate downloads. (Game and credits) 

3. Drag and drop ONLY the game file into your Applications folder. 

4. Open your finder and go to applications folder. 

5. Double click onto the game file and open (If it doesn't work, try command + double klick at the same time, eventually, it'll let you) 

_______________________________

If you have any questions left feel free to ask me, I'm always here to help! <3 Have fun playing and don't forget to save your progress! <3
